title: CTAM cycle catalog file descriptor
description: One entry in the immutable CTAMCycleCatalog, as returned by GET /files/{file_id} and as an item of GET /files. Physical paths are deliberately absent: they are not part of the portable module contract.

file_id.description: Opaque and stable within a cycle. Not stable across cycles, and never a path.

kind.description: The artifact class. Determines which validation rule applies.

family.description: Source family for kind=input, such as 'mrms' or 'goes'. Null for host-owned artifacts.

product.description: Product ID as recorded in the pinned CycleInputManifest, such as 'MergedReflectivityQCComposite_00.50'.

role.description: Which slot in the cycle this file fills. 'current' is the analysis time; 'previous' is the prior cycle StormProb needs for motion.

analysis_time.description: UTC, offset always written explicitly. Never naive.

available.description: The artifact exists and is readable. Says nothing about content.

validated.description: The artifact passed its kind-specific validation rule. Can be false while available is true.

readiness.description: Derived summary. 'ready' requires available and validated. A module must never infer readiness from 'available' alone.

reason.description: Null when readiness is 'ready'. Otherwise an actionable explanation.

size_bytes.description: Null when the artifact is unavailable.
